title: family_chat_e2ee
body:
### family_chat_e2ee_decrypt_failed
Could not decrypt. Refresh keys or wait for a resend.

### family_chat_e2ee_not_ready
Secure chat is not set up on this phone yet. Wait 5–10 seconds and try again. If it still fails, open Family Chat on another family device, then return here.

### family_chat_e2ee_setup
Setting up end-to-end encryption…
